parameters.jsCode:
const requester = $input.first().json;
const { rawSearch } = $('Parse Token & Query').first().json;

if (!requester.id || !requester.active) throw new Error('Invalid session or user not found.');

const searchPattern = `%${rawSearch}%`;

const sqlQuery = `
  -- 1. SEARCH CONTACTS (Added lead_status and lead_source to WHERE)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    'contact' AS entity_type,
    c.id,
    TRIM(CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name)) AS title,
    c.email AS subtitle,
    c.lead_status AS tag,
    co.name AS company
  FROM contacts c
  LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.account_id
  LEFT JOIN taggables tg ON (tg.entity_id = c.id AND tg.entity_type = 'contact')
  LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = tg.tag_id
  WHERE ($2 = 'admin' OR c.owner_id = $1)
    AND c.is_archived = false
    AND (
      c.first_name ILIKE $3 OR c.last_name ILIKE $3 OR c.email ILIKE $3 
      OR c.phone ILIKE $3 OR c.job_title ILIKE $3 OR c.city ILIKE $3 
      OR c.state ILIKE $3 OR c.country ILIKE $3 OR t.name ILIKE $3
      OR c.lead_status ILIKE $3   -- Added this
      OR c.lead_source ILIKE $3   -- Added this
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- 2. SEARCH COMPANIES
  SELECT DISTINCT
    'company' AS entity_type,
    cp.id,
    cp.name AS title,
    cp.industry AS subtitle,
    cp.city AS tag,
    cp.website AS company
  FROM companies cp
  LEFT JOIN taggables tg ON (tg.entity_id = cp.id AND tg.entity_type = 'company')
  LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = tg.tag_id
  WHERE ($2 = 'admin' OR cp.owner_id = $1)
    AND cp.is_archived = false
    AND (
      cp.name ILIKE $3 OR cp.industry ILIKE $3 OR cp.website ILIKE $3 
      OR cp.phone ILIKE $3 OR cp.city ILIKE $3 OR cp.state ILIKE $3 
      OR cp.country ILIKE $3 OR t.name ILIKE $3
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- 3. SEARCH OPPORTUNITIES (DEALS)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    'deal' AS entity_type,
    o.id,
    o.name AS title,
    CAST(o.deal_value AS TEXT) AS subtitle,
    o.status AS tag,
    '' AS company
  FROM opportunities o
  WHERE ($2 = 'admin' OR o.assigned_user = $1)
    AND (o.name ILIKE $3 OR o.status ILIKE $3)

  LIMIT 40;
`;

const queryParams = [requester.id, requester.role, searchPattern];

return [{ json: { sqlQuery, queryParams } }];
return [{ json: { contacts: [], deals: [], companies: [], totalMatches: 0 } }];
